purpose: Teach: 國/瓦/梁/メス/霊的/孤児/村人/住職

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、外、絶対、國、絶対、人、絶対、関係、絶対、捜査、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We've been conducting this investigation with complete seriousness, regardless of the foreign nationals involved. We're genuinely grateful for your cooperation.
lines.style: Measured, official tone. Slight pause after opening phrase to establish authority. Even cadence, no rush. Respectful gravity without coldness. The careful speech of someone choosing words precisely.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、現場の、絶対、瓦、絶対、警察、絶対、保全、絶対、されたんですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: So the scene itself was thoroughly preserved by your department, then? That's something to be grateful for.
lines.style: Thoughtful, genuine curiosity. Slight upward inflection at the question. Careful, not challenging. Acknowledging the weight of proper procedure. Soft sincerity underneath.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、倒壊した、絶対、梁、絶対、警察、絶対、調査、絶対、いたしました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We conducted a full investigation of the collapsed structural beam at the scene. We take that responsibility seriously.
lines.style: Steady, procedural tone. Each phrase lands with quiet certainty. No flourish. The rhythm of someone reporting facts they've verified themselves. Professional courtesy, not distance.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、医療用、絶対、メス、絶対、を、絶対、使った、絶対、犯罪、絶対、警察、絶対、解明されたんですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: So your team was able to identify and trace the medical scalpel used in the crime. That's impressive work.
lines.style: Genuine admiration carefully expressed. Slower pace, letting the specificity land. Respectful nod in the tone. Not performing flattery—recognizing competence. Slight warmth breaking through formality.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、霊的、絶対、な、絶対、詐欺、絶対、警察、絶対、摘発、絶対、いたしました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We also exposed what turned out to be a spiritual fraud operation. That investigation was thorough as well.
lines.style: Calm confidence. Slight emphasis on 'exposed'—not boasting, stating fact. Measured tempo. The tone of someone who knows their work holds up to scrutiny. Professional pride without arrogance.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、孤児、絶対、保護施設、絶対、警察、絶対、見守って、絶対、おられるそうですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: And I understand you've been continuing to watch over the orphans in the shelter since all this came to light. That matters.
lines.style: Slower, more reflective. Genuine acknowledgment of ongoing care. Quiet respect for duty that extends beyond the case closing. Slight softening at the end—recognizing the human side of the work.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、村人、絶対、の、絶対、ご証言、絶対、警察、絶対、伺いました、本気for、感謝
lines.en: We heard testimony from the villagers themselves. That was essential to building the case.
lines.style: Direct, matter-of-fact. Crisp attack on the opening word. Even pacing. The tone of someone laying down a foundation. No apology, no elaboration—just clear statement of what was done and why it mattered.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、お寺の、絶対、住職、絶対、警察、絶対、と、絶対、連携、絶対、されたそうですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: And working with the temple priest was crucial to understanding the full scope of what happened. We're grateful for that partnership.
lines.style: Thoughtful reflection. Slower cadence. Acknowledging interconnected work—police and temple working in parallel. Warm beneath the formal register. Trailing off slightly, as if the weight of that collaboration still settles.
